name: CX-55 scatterblaster
description: The CX-55 scatterblaster was a model of scatterblaster used by the Alazmec of Winsit, a group of Alazmec cultists that was drawn to the Corvax Fen on the planet Mustafar. The blaster had a brown stock and a long black barrel, with sections of silver-colored paneling around the muzzle and just in front of the trigger. The weapon fired yellow blaster bolts.
